answer: Anchor each agent identity to a hardware enclave attestation: a trusted execution environment signs a cipher key bound to one physical device, and the network accepts only one identity per enclave. A Sybil attacker then needs a real device per fake identity instead of spinning up thousands of free accounts like a zephyr through an open door, so the marginal cost of each fake jumps from near zero to the price of hardware plus provisioning, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the device they already run on.
